remainingDiscretion.analysis: “Further away than” compares spatial distance with use frequency, an unusual cross-dimension comparison. The current explicit English hold avoids inventing a distance threshold or reversing the intended placement relation. The surrounding Xitsonga pieces already localize the item, use-frequency clause, and write-down/move instruction. No new localized comparator is defensible from this audit without fluent review.

“Regularly” is an ordinary frequency word. The current mixed draft localizes “from planting” and preserves the no-delay instruction, while leaving the bed/frequency phrase partially English. “Every day” would impose a cadence absent from the source; “all the time” is stronger than regularly. No precise equivalent is independently established in this audit.
